deployments_detail.use: Autonomous construction-equipment tech (Maum AI VLA-model MOU, Jun 2026); voice-control AI (CES 2026, compact-equipment industry first)

Bobcat Jobsite Companion: an onboard AI voice assistant for compact construction equipment that lets operators ask questions and issue voice commands, adjusts attachment settings, gives recommendations, and automates 50+ machine functions. Runs entirely on-machine on Bobcat's proprietary AI large language model. Unveiled at CES 2026; a compact loader equipped with it is planned for US market launch summer 2026. [Bobcat proprietary AI large language model (onboard/edge)]

Agtonomy-enabled autonomous, electric Bobcat tractors (CT4045 diesel and AT450X). Factory-fitted Physical AI software enables vision-based autonomous operation with no base stations or pre-mapping; a single operator can manage 10+ tractors simultaneously. Marketed as available/in stock for agriculture and landscaping. [Agtonomy (Physical AI, vision-based autonomy)]

MAUM.AI pilot to develop and validate an end-to-end autonomous loader solution based on a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) AI model connecting perception, language understanding and real-world actions, for use on construction sites, mining and logistics facilities. Pilot runs June-December 2026. [MAUM.AI (VLA foundation model / robotic brain)]

Strategic collaboration with NVIDIA on Physical AI: exploring integration of NVIDIA physical-AI technologies and specialized world models into Doosan Bobcat equipment across construction, landscaping, agriculture and material handling, so machines can perceive environments, reason about conditions and operate more autonomously. [NVIDIA (physical AI, world models, Omniverse/Isaac)]

MOU with MAUM.AI for joint feasibility studies and demonstrations of VLA-based autonomous operation technology for compact construction equipment; Doosan Bobcat contributes equipment and operational data while MAUM.AI applies its VLA robotic-brain models. [MAUM.AI (VLA models)]

RogueX3 fully-electric autonomous compact loader concept: cab-free/cab-optional modular platform with autonomy-ready intelligence, remote operation and programmable autonomous tasks; latest evolution of the RogueX autonomous concept line, shown at CES 2026. [Bobcat (autonomous concept platform)]

Bobcat Machine IQ telematics platform: cloud-connected system delivering real-time machine health, fault-code diagnostics, utilization/fuel analytics, maintenance scheduling and proactive servicing alerts plus remote engine disable for theft prevention. Fully deployed in production with 30,000+ connected units in Europe as of Oct 2025. [Bobcat (proprietary telematics/analytics)]

Service.AI: an AI-powered service platform for dealers and technicians giving instant access to repair manuals, warranty details, real-time diagnostics and historical troubleshooting cases to accelerate diagnostics and repair. Announced/demonstrated at CES 2026. [Doosan Bobcat (vendor not disclosed)]

Advanced Display Technology and Collision Warning & Avoidance System: MicroLED transparent smart-cab display with 360-degree cameras plus imaging-radar-based hazard detection that senses nearby people/machines and utilities, warns operators and can automatically slow or stop the machine to prevent collisions. Prototype/concept shown at CES 2026. [Bobcat (imaging radar, computer vision)]
